primaryTextChecks.text: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

context.text: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

context.text: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.
